item.title: Mackenzie Dern net worth in 2026: UFC salary, fight earnings and sponsorships
item.summary: Mackenzie Dern's net worth is estimated at $2.5 million in 2026. Her UFC fight purses range from $110,000 to $150,000 per bout. Performance bonuses and commercial partnerships add significantly to her income. Dern has secured around $900,000 in total career fight earnings. She is preparing to defend her strawweight title against Gillian Robertson.
